label: TP
reason: Two genuine vulnerabilities identified: (1) Line 81 uses Math.random() for session key generation which is cryptographically weak and predictable; (2) Lines 91-96 reflect unsanitized user input from request.getParameter() directly into HTML response via PrintWriter.println(), enabling XSS attacks.

evidence.note: Uses Math.random() to generate rememberMeKey - cryptographically weak PRNG
User input concatenated directly into HTML response without encoding
